responsibility: Implements GCC’s interprocedural stack-scrubbing (“strub”) support as a pair of simple IPA passes. This file analyzes functions and variables with strub attributes, chooses and verifies viable strub modes, enforces call/inlining compatibility, and then rewrites affected callgraph nodes and GIMPLE bodies to realize the selected mode, including wrapper creation, interface changes such as watermark parameters, insertion of enter/leave scrubbing calls and EH-cleanup paths, and related diagnostics for unsupported combinations.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for strub: unlike ipa-strub.h, which only exposes cross-module predicates and type/declaration utilities, it contains the IPA passes that select strub modes, diagnose incompatibilities, and rewrite callgraph nodes and GIMPLE bodies to realize stack scrubbing.
